pattern: One model per question. Bare model codes only. Gold states the limit in 75 words or fewer. Both arms may use up to 150 words.

questions.question: Can a GNE27JYMFS owner turn on FridgeFocus crisper camera checks from the 2026 GE Profile Kitchen Assistant announcement?
questions.answer: No. FridgeFocus and the interior inventory camera belong to the announced GE Profile four-door refrigerator. They are not on the GNE27JYMFS and cannot be added by an update.

criteria.text: FridgeFocus and the inventory camera cannot be added to the GNE27JYMFS.

questions.question: Does GE ending manufacture of GNE27JYMFS cancel the limited warranty on refrigerators already sold?
questions.answer: No. Ending manufacture is not the same as canceling warranty. Warranty coverage, parts availability, and recalls are separate questions that each need their own evidence.

criteria.text: Ending manufacture does not cancel the limited warranty on units already sold.

questions.question: KitchenAid advertised the MindFULLness Fridge with Corkcicle. Does that add Intelligent Auto Fill or meditation dispensing to KRFF507HPS?
questions.answer: No. MindFULLness is a promotional experience on newer Intelligent Auto Fill models. The KRFF507HPS has a standard through-the-door dispenser only.

criteria.text: MindFULLness does not add Intelligent Auto Fill to the KRFF507HPS.

questions.question: A GNE27JYMFS owner asks whether GE's Scan-to-List barcode scanner in the dispenser can be enabled through SmartHQ on their unit.
questions.answer: No. Scan-to-List and the exterior barcode scanner are on the new GE Profile refrigerator line. GE's release does not offer them as a retrofit for GNE27JYMFS owners.

criteria.text: Scan-to-List cannot be enabled on the GNE27JYMFS through SmartHQ.

questions.question: Can Sphere Ice or the dual automatic ice makers from the 2026 Bespoke announcement be installed on an existing RF28K9070SG?
questions.answer: No. Sphere Ice and the tall dispenser options belong to new three-door Bespoke models. Samsung's announcement does not add them to the four-door RF28K9070SG.

criteria.text: Sphere Ice and the dual ice makers are not an install option on the RF28K9070SG.

questions.question: An RF28K9070SG owner wants the Family Hub screen and Gemini food recognition from Samsung's September 2026 software news. Will this model receive that update?
questions.answer: No. The September 2026 update targets selected newer Family Hub models with compatible screens and cameras. It does not name the RF28K9070SG as eligible.

criteria.text: The RF28K9070SG is not named as eligible for the Family Hub Gemini update.

questions.question: Retailer reviews for RF28K9070SG mention ice-maker problems. May support quote those review percentages as an official failure rate?
questions.answer: No. Best Buy and Home Depot review percentages reflect posted owner sentiment, not measured failure rates and not a recall. Symptom wording still matters for triage.

criteria.text: Review percentages are not an official failure rate or a recall.

questions.question: Does the GNE27JYMFS user guide's Turbo Cool button prove the model is still in current GE production?
questions.answer: No. Turbo Cool is documented for installed units. GE's listing separately says GNE27JYMFS is no longer being manufactured, which is not a recall.

criteria.text: Turbo Cool in the guide does not prove the GNE27JYMFS is still in current production.

questions.question: Lowe's shows 4.3/5 for KRFF507HPS with ice-maker complaints in the text. Does that score prove KitchenAid added Intelligent Auto Fill to this model?
questions.answer: No. The Lowe's score summarizes owner sentiment about KRFF507HPS. It is not a product announcement, and KRFF507HPS does not include Intelligent Auto Fill.

criteria.text: The Lowe's score does not prove Intelligent Auto Fill was added to KRFF507HPS.

questions.question: RTINGS notes the GNE27JYMFS ice bin uses noticeable freezer-drawer space. Should staff treat that as proof the freezer failed?
questions.answer: No. RTINGS scored ice making 8.4/10 while noting bin space trade-offs. That is not automatic proof of a failed freezer or a cooling defect.

criteria.text: Ice bin space use is not automatic proof of a failed freezer.

questions.question: A GNE27JYMFS owner asks whether the Instacart-linked grocery list from GE's Kitchen Assistant announcement can be turned on through SmartHQ on their refrigerator.
questions.answer: No. Instacart-linked Scan-to-List grocery features belong to the announced GE Profile refrigerator line. GE's release does not offer them as a SmartHQ enablement on the GNE27JYMFS.

criteria.text: Instacart-linked Scan-to-List cannot be enabled on the GNE27JYMFS through SmartHQ.

questions.question: GE's listing shows GNE27JYMFS as temporarily unavailable online. Does that prove every retailer has zero units in stock nationwide?
questions.answer: No. One seller's online unavailability is not proof that all retail inventory is gone. Stock depends on seller, location, and time. Confirm with the specific retailer or store.

criteria.text: Online unavailability on one listing does not prove zero nationwide retail stock.

questions.question: KitchenAid's Corkcicle MindFULLness sweepstakes awards five special refrigerators. Does that mean Intelligent Auto Fill is now standard on every KRFF507HPS sold at Lowe's?
questions.answer: No. The sweepstakes awards five promotional units. It does not retrofit or upgrade KRFF507HPS models already in stores. KRFF507HPS still lacks Intelligent Auto Fill.

criteria.text: The sweepstakes does not make Intelligent Auto Fill standard on KRFF507HPS.

questions.question: KitchenAid's KBIS 2026 counter-depth French-door line advertises Intelligent Auto Fill. Can that dispenser be field-installed on an existing KRFF507HPS?

criteria.text: KBIS 2026 Intelligent Auto Fill is not a field retrofit for KRFF507HPS.

questions.question: Samsung's September 2026 software news omits RF28K9070SG. May staff still tell owners the update might arrive later if they wait?

criteria.text: Staff must not promise a future Family Hub or Gemini update for RF28K9070SG.

questions.question: Best Buy says 84% of RF28K9070SG reviewers would recommend the model. May support treat that as Samsung's official reliability certification?
questions.answer: No. Eighty-four percent recommending is posted reviewer sentiment, not an official Samsung reliability certification. It is not a measured failure rate or a recall.

questions.question: GE's Kitchen Assistant announcement highlights an eight-inch display. Can a GNE27JYMFS owner buy that display as an accessory and mount it on their refrigerator?

criteria.text: The eight-inch display is not an accessory retrofit for the GNE27JYMFS.

criteria.text: Measured Fill on KRFF507HPS is not the MindFULLness meditation experience.

questions.question: GE's model page says GNE27JYMFS is no longer manufactured. Does that statement alone prove parts and factory service are permanently unavailable for installed units?
questions.answer: No. Ending manufacture is not proof that parts or service are unavailable. Parts access, warranty, and recalls are separate questions that need their own evidence.

criteria.text: Discontinuation alone does not prove parts or service are permanently unavailable.

questions.question: Samsung's April 2026 Bespoke line advertises Zero Clearance Fit hinges for flush cabinetry. Can those hinges be installed on an existing RF28K9070SG four-door unit?
questions.answer: No. Zero Clearance Fit hinges belong to newly announced three-door Bespoke models. Samsung's announcement does not describe retrofitting them onto the four-door RF28K9070SG.
